expected.notes: Today is Thu 19 Nov 2026 and pay is the last Friday, so payday is Fri 27 Nov (8 days away): the window is days 0 to 7 (19 to 26 Nov), and anything dated on payday belongs to the next period. The same account, bill and credit as the Kevin scenario, but the credit is due Sun 22 Nov (day 3), the day before the bill. G479 (Kevin 2026-11-19, option A): Left to spend is what can be spent without any payment failing. Each counted current account contributes its LOWEST balance before payday (the lowest running balance after any of its payments, or its closing balance if that is lower, or its overdraft), money in counted only from its expected date; a dip below zero is a shortfall and reduces the total, never floored away (contribution = max(0, figure), uncovered shortfall = max(0, -figure), the total is their signed sum). Walk: 34.89 + 649.59 = 684.48 on 22 Nov, then - 77.91 = 606.57 on 23 Nov. The only payment is the 77.91 and the balance after it is 606.57, which is also the closing figure, so the account's lowest balance after a payment is 606.57: no dip, no shortfall, contribution 606.57. (Once the money in the first scenario has landed, its figure returns to this same 606.57.) The cover engine's gated walk has the same credit: after payments 606.57, low point 34.89 (the opening balance, its low-point rule), covered. At risk 0.
